title: On Windows, the destructive-git brief check reads a scratch-repo path as inside the scratchpad
why: Coordinator 23:13 CST Nov 8: workflow_dispatch run 42561302134 failed checks-windows-guard-2 and checks-windows-guard-3 on two Agent-tool cases of rule brief-destructive-git already on main (hooks/test_guard.py: the scratch-repo case, and likely BRIEF_ALLOW_PARAGRAPHS). The fixture joins an unquoted `C:\...` SCRATCH_REPO into the brief; the brief reader drops the backslashes as bash does, so the path no longer reads as inside a scratchpad and the brief is denied.
